name: amazon-spending-analyzer
description: Ingest, categorize, analyze, and dashboard Amazon order-history exports with Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Analyze Amazon order exports with deterministic scripts and Codex category review.
interface.longDescription: Amazon Spending Analyzer ingests Amazon Your Orders exports into annual categorized CSVs, lets Codex resolve only the ambiguous category review rows, answers aggregate spending questions, and builds a static HTML dashboard.
interface.defaultPrompt: Ingest my Amazon order export, resolve remaining categories, and summarize my biggest spending categories.
